Subsequent trials were able to successfully mitigate the apparent psychological damage, but proved the need for particularly physically fit test subjects.

Note: Trial runs 4.3 through 5.2 indicated subjects with an otherwise alarmingly high BI would be the best candidates for further study. As they are in short supply, additional tests were unable to investigate this phenomenon.”— The Whitespring Bunker terminal entries
**Empath** is a mutation in *Fallout 76*.
